name: us-home-sale-exclusion-121
description: Work out how much gain on the sale of a main home a US taxpayer can exclude in tax year 2026 under section 121, the USD 250,000 single and USD 500,000 joint limits, the 2-of-5-year ownership and use tests, the once-every-2-years rule, the partial exclusion for a work, health or unforeseen move, depreciation after 6 May 1997 that stays taxable, and gain allocated to nonqualified use after 2008. Includes the decision whether to sell now or wait to pass the 2-year test. Trigger on "sell my house", "home sale exclusion", "section 121", "capital gains on my home", "2 out of 5 years", "partial exclusion", "rented my home before selling". Federal only.
